description: Send a question to the school without a full trip configuration. Requires OAuth requests scope. Optional idempotency_key.

configuration.description: Same shape as the Extralingo school-page configurator: startDate (YYYY-MM-DD), students[] with courseId, weeks, optional accommodationGroupId, mealType, extras.

mealType.description: Meal plan key when accommodation is selected.

startDate.description: Course start calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Typically a Monday from list_starting_dates.

students.description: One object per traveller. courseId comes from list_courses.

courseId.description: Course product id from list_courses for this school.

contact.description: Optional first_name, last_name. Email always comes from the verified account.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for prices in this call. Usually EUR.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same semantics as create_booking (24 hour replay window).

school_id.description: Craft CMS school entry id from search_language_schools hits (field school_id). Not the CRM UUID.

name: ask_school_question

newBookingId.description: Craft newBookings entry id when created.

redirectUrl.description: Extralingo /my URL for the student to follow the request, when available.
